attributes.action: National Amber alert for missing children under 18
attributes.additional_details: We have seen many children go missing with devastating results. We believe a national alert system could help to drastically reduce the time it takes to find a child and returning them home safe and sound. Our children are not safe anymore. With an Amber alert on your phone, tv, radio, motorways, and any other digital source, will get many more people searching for the missing child and reducing the amount of deaths of these poor children and their families heartache.
attributes.background:
The Government should introduce a national alert system which alerts every phone, motorway, digital source and media in the country when a child under 18 goes missing.
I, and many others, believe a national alert system could help to drastically reduce the time it takes to find a child

rejection.details:
